select r.resume_id AS resumeId, r.user_id AS userId, r.title, r.name_kor, r.name_eng, r.name_han, r.birth_date, r.gender, r.phone_number, r.email, r.address1, r.address2,
r.industryCode, r.jobCode, r.roleCode, r.companyCode, r.appliedField, r.companyName, r.careerCode,
r.hiddenIndustry, r.hiddenJob, r.hiddenRole, r.hiddenCompanyType, r.veteran_status, r.veteran_number, r.disability_status, r.disability_grade, r.multicultural_status, r.north_defector, r.low_income_status, r.military_service, r.military_branch, r.military_rank, r.discharge_reason, r.enlist_date, r.discharge_date, r.exemption_reason,
e.edu_id, e.education_level, e.school_name, e.department, e.major, e.minor_major, e.major_sub, e.hakjum, e.hakjum_scale, e.edu_start_day, e.edu_end_day
FROM resume r LEFT JOIN resume_education e ON r.resume_id = e.resume_id LEFT JOIN resume_experience x ON r.resume_id = x.resume_id
WHERE r.resume_id = #{resumeId}
